function_under_test: cli.commands.run._run_direct_target (the real production path 'agentdx run <fixture>' itself calls), via bench.harness._real_fixture_run.run_fixture_fresh
method: For each real fixture, 90 in-process replays plus 10 fresh-OS-subprocess replays (100 total, >=10 in fresh processes per the PRD's own wording), each against an isolated, fresh data directory so run_id's D-80 cache-reuse path never turns a 'replay' into a cache hit. canonical_log_hash is computed per run; the published number is the count of distinct hashes across all 100.
requirement_text: Method: 100 replays per fixture, >=10 in fresh processes; count distinct canonical log hashes. Gate: exactly 1 distinct hash per fixture. Published as: '100/100 identical' per fixture, with the hash.
